clue.text: Mark is without a vehicle, so here is a litter

indicators.note: here without means outside, so the word for a mark wraps round the vehicle

parts.note: a brand is a mark burnt or stamped on something
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone observes that Mark has no car, so a stretcher will have to do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' is used in its old sense of 'outside', not 'lacking'; a brancard is a rare word for a horse litter.
explanation.definitionFit: A brancard is a horse-borne stretcher, a kind of litter for carrying the sick.

clue.text: Pudding which does not have a bowl?

definitions.meaning: a ... pudding, such as Yorkshire pudding, is made from this mixture

definitions.text: which does not have a bowl?
definitions.meaning: in cricket the batsman faces the bowling and does not bowl

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the batter strikes the ball and the bowler delivers it, so the batter gets no bowl.
explanation.definitionFit: Batter is a flour-and-egg mixture baked as a pudding, and also a batsman, who hits rather than bowls in cricket.

clue.text: There is nothing in a place to live on the water

indicators.note: in places nothing inside the home's letters

parts.note: a flat is a home, giving A FLAT
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: There's nowhere to live except a houseboat.
explanation.definitionFit: Afloat means floating, borne up on the surface of the sea or a river.

clue.text: Pussy climbs into a broken saucer for the shrimps

indicators.note: into puts the cat inside the broken saucer
broken means the letters of saucer are smashed and rearranged
in a down clue climbing means the word reads upwards, so backwards

parts.note: pussy is a cat

explanation.surface: A cat clambers into a smashed dish to get at the prawns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climbs' works only because this is a down clue, where the cat reads upwards; the broken saucer gives CRUSEA.
explanation.definitionFit: Crustacea is the zoological class including shrimps, crabs and lobsters.

clue.text: Ugly beasts but they make the odd one rich in flowers

indicators.note: odd suggests the letters of one rich are set out strangely

parts.note: roses are flowers

explanation.surface: Unlovely animals turn a single oddity into wealth among the flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd' rearranges ONE RICH to RHINOCE, followed by ROSES.
explanation.definitionFit: These large thick-skinned horned mammals are hardly beautiful.

clue.text: Make impotent by destroying tenure

indicators.note: destroying the word tenure breaks its letters up for rearranging

explanation.surface: A tenant is unmanned by losing the security of his tenancy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by destroying' tells you to rearrange the letters of TENURE.
explanation.definitionFit: To neuter an animal is to castrate or spay it, leaving it unable to breed.

clue.text: Girl needs one measure after another

indicators.note: after places the first measure behind the second

parts.note: an ell is an old measure of length
an en is a printer's measure of width

explanation.surface: A girl wants one unit then a second.
explanation.definitionFit: Ellen is a female first name.

clue.text: Three runs for where the spectators are

parts.note: ter is Latin for three times, used in music and medicine
races are runs

explanation.surface: Three runs scored while the crowd watches.
explanation.definitionFit: Terraces are tiers of standing room for crowds at a football ground.

clue.text: Fools enter most of the others to provide a fresh estimate

indicators.note: enter puts the fools inside the shortened word
most of means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: the rest are the others
asses are fools

explanation.surface: Idiots joining the majority demand a new valuation.
explanation.definitionFit: To reassess is to evaluate again and form a new judgement.

clue.text: Inform an ancient city in charge of the earth

parts.note: to inform is to tell
Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: Someone is told to report an old city that rules over the world.
explanation.definitionFit: Telluric comes from Latin tellus, ground, and means relating to the planet we live on.

clue.text: Woman who lets a liar go free

indicators.note: setting the letters free lets them fall into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A forgiving woman allows a dishonest person to walk away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free' is the anagram signal: the letters of LIAR and GO are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Gloria is a female given name.

clue.text: Rear in a rustic cottage?

parts.note: a hind is a farm labourer, a rustic
quarters are living accommodation, such as a cottage

explanation.surface: A country cottage seen from the back.
explanation.definitionFit: The hindquarters are the back legs and rump of an animal, its rear end.

clue.text: Just when love loses its head

indicators.note: losing its head means the first letter of the phrase is dropped

parts.note: lovemaking, the time when people make love, is the sex act

explanation.surface: Exactly at the moment romance loses its senses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses its head' drops the S from SEX ACT, leaving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Just in the sense of precise or accurate, as in 'the just amount'.

clue.text: Foreigners who may masquerade as relations

indicators.note: a masquerade is a disguise, so the letters of relations put on a new form

explanation.surface: Strangers turn up pretending to be family members.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may masquerade as' signals rearranging the letters of RELATIONS.
explanation.definitionFit: Orientals, people from the East, were seen as foreigners from a Western viewpoint.

clue.text: Tools which are no use for a straight shot?

definitions.text: Tools which are no use for a straight shot?

parts.words: Tools which are no use for a straight shot?
parts.note: a screw is a shot with spin, as in billiards or golf, so a driver of screw shots cannot hit straight; also hand tools for turning screws

explanation.surface: Equipment that would ruin a golfer's straight drive.
explanation.walkthrough: In billiards and other games a screw is a shot with spin put on the ball, so the tool name reads as one who drives screws rather than straight shots.
explanation.definitionFit: These are hand tools for turning the slotted heads of screws.

clue.text: One who makes a mess of realities

indicators.note: making a mess of the letters jumbles them into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone who confuses fact and fiction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'makes a mess of' rearranges REALITIES; the bare 'One' is a thin definition, a person of a people.
explanation.definitionFit: An Israelite is one member of the ancient Hebrew people.

clue.text: Physical fighter

explanation.definitionFit: Corporal means bodily, as in corporal punishment, and is also an army rank just above private.

clue.text: The holiday-maker would make this entertainer lose her head

definitions.text: The holiday-maker would make this entertainer lose her head

parts.words: The holiday-maker would make this entertainer lose her head
parts.note: a holiday-maker is a tripper, which is this performer's name with its first letter removed

explanation.surface: A tourist so distracts a performer that she loses her composure.
explanation.walkthrough: Behead the entertainer and you get TRIPPER, a holiday-maker.
explanation.definitionFit: A stripper is a striptease artiste, a performer who undresses on stage.

clue.text: Get the better of someone in being not at home with the work

parts.note: someone not at home is out
a man is a human being
oeuvre is French for work, used in English for an artist's body of work

explanation.surface: Beating a rival because they were away from home while you worked.
explanation.definitionFit: To outmanoeuvre someone is to outwit them by cleverer tactics.

clue.text: Ancient widow

definitions.meaning: a survivor of a former age
an old legal word for a surviving spouse

explanation.definitionFit: Relict means something surviving from the past, and formerly a woman whose husband has died.

clue.text: Cook's work in which one woman is superior to the others

indicators.note: in a down clue superior means placed above, so one woman's name comes first

parts.note: Di is a woman's name
shes are females, the other women

explanation.surface: A kitchen contest in which one woman outshines the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Dishes are prepared items of food, what a cook produces.

clue.text: Vessel in which a soldier is put ahead of the Queen

indicators.note: put ahead of means the soldier's word comes before the queen's

parts.note: a private is a soldier of the lowest rank
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A ship on which an ordinary trooper is given precedence over the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A privateer was a privately owned armed ship licensed to attack enemy shipping.

clue.text: To cause confusion give the French as well

parts.note: to add something is to give it as well
le is French for the

explanation.surface: To muddle things, throw in the French too.
explanation.definitionFit: To addle is to muddle or confuse.

clue.text: Something fragrant in the novel emitted by the heroine

indicators.note: the answer lies in the run of letters spanning the words novel emitted

explanation.surface: A scent drifts off the heroine in a romantic novel.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit across 'novEL EMItted'; 'by the heroine' only dresses the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Elemi is an aromatic resin used in perfumes and varnishes.

clue.text: Rushing waters are quiet during attacks

indicators.note: during puts the quiet letter in the middle of the attacks

parts.note: raids are attacks
P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: The torrents fall silent while assaults go on.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapids are stretches of a river where water flows fast and broken over rocks.

clue.text: Wicked as sin inside a vessel

indicators.note: inside puts the word for sin within the vessel's word

parts.note: a dish is a vessel for food
evil is wrongdoing, sin

explanation.surface: Something as sinful as wrongdoing lurking in a bowl.
explanation.definitionFit: Devilish means fiendish, as bad as a demon would be.

clue.text: Played about when con dueted round where the animals were

indicators.note: round means the conducted word goes about the place for animals

parts.note: led is the past of lead, to conduct
Noah's ark held the animals during the flood

explanation.surface: Someone fooled around while guiding a party round the zoo.
explanation.definitionFit: To lark is to frolic or play pranks, so larked is fooled about.

clue.text: It stands up to fire with the finest in an emergency

indicators.note: in puts the finest inside the distress call

parts.note: an SOS is an emergency signal, giving A SOS
best means the finest

explanation.surface: The best people turn out for a fire emergency.
explanation.walkthrough: BEST goes inside A SOS, after its first S.
explanation.definitionFit: Asbestos is a fibrous mineral formerly used for fireproofing.
